parts.title: Excessive bank from 1000 ft to 500 ft

phases.trigger: stopped, under 2 kt on the ground (0 kt)
moving on the ground under 30 kt (2 kt)
on the ground above 30 kt (30.1 kt)
35 ft above the runway (36 ft RA)
climbing through 1000 ft above the aerodrome (1001 ft AAL)
descending through 1000 ft above the aerodrome (999 ft AAL)

events.title: Excessive bank from 1000 ft to 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle from 1000 ft to 500 ft, held 3 s. EASA Data4Safety, above 500 ft: more than 15 deg (SL1) or 30 deg (SL2A).
events.why_it_matters: Still turning steeply on final means the aircraft is not lined up, and bank raises the stall speed close to the ground.
events.advice: Plan the turn onto final so it is complete with shallow bank well before 500 ft.

events.title: High descent rate above 500 ft
events.description: Descent rate from 1000 ft to 500 ft. EASA Data4Safety, above 500 ft: more than 1200 fpm (SL1) or 1500 fpm (SL2A). Held 5 s, Data4Safety's persistence for the first threshold (3 s for the second; a rule has one).
events.why_it_matters: A sustained high descent rate close to the ground leaves little room to arrest it and is a classic precursor of hard landings and controlled flight into terrain.
events.advice: Stay on a stable path; if it needs more than 1000 fpm below 1000 ft, the approach is too high: go around and set up again.

events.title: Excessive bank below 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle below 500 ft, held 3 s. EASA Data4Safety, below 500 ft: more than 15 deg (SL2B) or 30 deg (SL3). Light aircraft: `bank-light`.
events.why_it_matters: Steep bank close to the ground raises the stall speed (about 7% at 20 deg, 41% at 45 deg) and risks a wingtip strike; a stall in a low turn is rarely recoverable.
events.advice: Plan the pattern so the turn to final is complete with shallow bank (15 deg or less) well above 500 ft. Overshooting final: go around, do not tighten the turn.

events.title: High descent rate at 500 ft
events.description: Rate of descent at the 500 ft gate against the FSF ALAR stabilised approach limit, 1000 fpm. An advisory: the descent below 500 ft is graded by `high-sink-below-500` and `high-sink-light`.
events.why_it_matters: A steep, fast descent at 500 ft leaves little height to arrest the sink, a common precursor of hard and short landings.
events.advice: Fly a stable path of about 3 degrees (roughly 500-700 fpm in a light aircraft, 700-800 fpm in a jet). More than 1000 fpm at the gate: go around.

events.title: Bank at 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle at the 500 ft gate against the EAFDM stabilised-approach limit, 7 deg. An advisory: bank is graded by `bank-above-500`, `bank-below-500` and `bank-light`.
events.why_it_matters: Still turning at 500 ft means the aircraft is not lined up with the runway, and bank raises the stall speed close to the ground.
events.advice: Roll out on final above 500 ft: extend the downwind or widen the base turn so the final is straight and wings-level. Not aligned at the gate: go around.
